files: weapon files: {parameters "<ammo tags>" ..} blocks (piercing, range, speed per round)
resource/set/interaction_terrain/effects/*.inc and set/interaction_entity/tank/*.inc (effects and damage scripts by tag)

groups.name: What it is and what it copies
Piercing by range (in the weapon file)
Flight, range, reload with this round (in the weapon file)

vars.where: file name <family>.<type>.ammo
vars.plain: Name of the round; its tags come from the file name split on dots (bullet75.ap.ammo -> bullet75 ap).
vars.tool: gen clone (stuff + tags)

vars.where: first part of the file name (bulletNN, ammo rifle ...)
vars.plain: The shell family a weapon loads with filling; a bulletNN name also gives the weapon its calibre.
vars.tool: gen clone tags

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: root word
vars.plain: The engine kind: bullet (a round) or item.
vars.tool: gen clone (inherits it)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {from "pattern x"}
vars.plain: The round or pattern this one copies (pattern ap, pattern fg, pattern apcr ...).
vars.tool: gen clone stuff

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {tag} class word
vars.plain: Kind of round (ap, apcr, fg high explosive, sm smoke, cumulative HEAT); picks the weapon's parameters block and the computer's ammo choice.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {tag} size_<x>
vars.plain: Size word that picks the hit and explosion effects and sounds on the ground.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {tag} shell_<x>
vars.plain: Class word the vehicle damage scripts read (how badly a hit hurts crew and parts).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {tag} other words
vars.plain: Other words: big, pierce (scripts react to piercing), no_ricochet, stackable, dropboxed, itemin2hands.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {mass}
vars.plain: Weight of one round.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/mass, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {desc}
vars.plain: Optional text key for the name instead of the one made from the tags.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/desc, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {entity}
vars.plain: Model of the round when it lies in inventory or on the ground.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/entity, op add)

vars.where: entity/inventory/-ammo/<e>/<e>.{def,mdl,ply,mtl,dds}
vars.plain: The round's model files and skin.
vars.tool: gen clone (entity + as, copy_assets) / /art/copy

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {view "entity"}
vars.plain: Model drawn while the round flies (rockets, grenades); shells use the weapon's bullet_view.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/view, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {view "e" {tail "entity" "bone"}}
vars.plain: Smoke or flame trail fixed to a bone of the flying model.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/view/tail, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {trace {view "texture" ..}} or ("ap"|"apcr" args k)
vars.plain: Tracer picture drawn behind the round.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/trace/view, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {trace {view .. {Light}}}
vars.plain: Brightness of the tracer.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/trace/view/Light, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {trace {view .. {ScaleY} {ScaleX}}}
vars.plain: Thickness of the tracer.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/trace/view/ScaleY, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {trace {length}}
vars.plain: Length of the tracer; the presets take it from the args number.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/trace/length, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: ("ap"|"apcr"|"fg"|"fg_medium"|"fg_heavy" args k)
vars.plain: One number that sizes the preset: tracer length for AP, blast strength and radius for HE.

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {detonationThickness}
vars.plain: Fuse: a plate at least this thick stops the round and sets it off (HE 2, rockets 1); never when left out.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/detonationThickness, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {applyProjectile}
vars.plain: An exploding round also deals its piercing hit.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/applyProjectile, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {cumulative}
vars.plain: HEAT: how far the jet reaches past the point of impact.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/cumulative, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage [add] blastwave {energy}}
vars.plain: Strength of a blast layer.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/damage/energy, op add) (first layer only)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage [add] blastwave {area inner outer}}
vars.plain: Full strength inside the first radius, falling to nothing at the second.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/damage/area, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage add blastwave ..}
vars.plain: Adds another blast layer; without add the first inherited layer is replaced.

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage fire {radius}}
vars.plain: Radius set on fire.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/damage/radius, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage fire {heating}}

vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/damage/heating, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage fire {time}}

vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/damage/time, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage fire {follow uid}}

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage flash {radius near far} {duration near far}}

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {damage cumulative {damage mm} {distance m}}
vars.plain: A shaped charge as a second invisible shot (vanilla: anti-tank grenades only).

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {possibleDamageRadius}

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {inventory {size w h}}
vars.plain: Inventory cells one round (or stack) takes.

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {inventory {weight}}
vars.plain: Inventory weight.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/inventory/weight, op add)

vars.where: ammo file set/stuff/shell/<family>.<type>.ammo, set/stuff/{ammo,bazooka,reactive,bombing}/<name>.ammo, or its pattern/presets: {inventory {block n}}

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {projectileDamage}

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {healthDamage}
vars.plain: Damage of this round to soldiers.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/healthDamage, op add)

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {range a b}
vars.plain: Range with this round (HE and APCR shoot shorter in vanilla presets).

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {speed}

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {gravity}

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {rechargeTime}

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {spreading ..}
vars.plain: Spread with this round (vanilla cannon presets widen it for HE and APCR).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/spreading, op add)

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {curve}
vars.plain: Energy-by-distance curve for this round.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/curve, op add)

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {cursor} {cursorReloading}
vars.plain: Cursor shown when this round is loaded.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/cursor, op add)

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {bullet_view}
vars.plain: Flying look of this round from this weapon.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/bullet_view, op add)

vars.where: weapon file {parameters "<ammo tags>" {..}} {TraceFreq}
vars.plain: Tracer frequency with this round.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/parameters/TraceFreq, op add)

vars.where: set/target/ammo.set rules matched by ammo tags
vars.plain: Which targets the computer fires this round at; a round no rule names is never chosen.

vars.where: set/interaction_terrain/effects/*.inc, picked by tags shell size_<x> fg
vars.plain: Hit and explosion effects on the ground, chosen from the size and kind tags (no own key).
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: interaction effects by tag -> sound/detonation/...
vars.plain: Explosion and hit sound, chosen from the tags like the effects.
vars.tool: gen set (entity file:<stuff key>, path <root>/tag, op add)

vars.where: vehicle def {extender "inventory" {box {item "ammo <family> <type>" n}}}
vars.plain: How many of this round a vehicle stores.
vars.tool: gen weapon (swaps family) / gen set

vars.where: vehicle {weaponry {place {weapon "gun" filling "ammo <family> <type>" 1}}}
vars.plain: Round loaded in the gun at start.
vars.tool: gen weapon

vars.where: breed {inventory {item "ammo tags" n}}
vars.plain: Rounds a soldier carries.
vars.tool: gen breed set (+inventory/item)

vars.where: desc.lng desc/ammo/<tags> (or mod #file.lng)
vars.plain: Name of the round in the game; key made from its tags minus grenade pattern ammo weapon.
vars.tool: gen clone name / gen text

gaps: no op makes a new round from a like round with its numbers -> op shell (name family.type, like, preset args, blast layers [{energy, area}], detonation, tracer {texture, length}, tags size/shell class)
preset arg ("ap"|"fg"|"fg_heavy" args k) cannot be edited by gen set (macro call) -> op shell field args, like gen armor edits armor_* args
second and later blast layers ({damage add blastwave}) cannot be addressed by gen set paths -> op shell field blast: list of layers written whole
per-round weapon values (range, speed, recharge, spreading in {parameters "tags"}) only by raw gen set -> op gun field params
AI ammo rules (set/target/ammo.set) for a new kind tag: no op -> op ammorule (tag, like tag) copying the rows of an existing kind
round model / flight model / trail: no op clones an -ammo inventory entity and re-points it -> op stuffmodel (shared with gun)
vehicle box counts and soldier ammo lines -> op box / op kit (shared with gun)
hit/explosion sound per tag is chosen in interaction effects: needs an in-game test to map tag -> sound [T]
